title.purpose: The name of a view. One per sheet.

heading.purpose: The generated feature name on a results sheet.

subheading.purpose: Selected test case title in the detail pane.

body.purpose: All running copy, list titles at 500, and button labels. Measure capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Section rules, title-block fields, priority marks. Never sits above a heading.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The only shadow. Keeps a sheet's bottom edge from dissolving into the stock at low gamma. Never grows, never signals state.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: A sheet settling into the binder on view change. Exponential ease-out from an already-visible default; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background and border colour changes on hover, selection, and focus.

motion.name: sheet-scan
motion.purpose: Loading: a rule read left to right across a hairline, in place of a spinner.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single concluding action on a sheet. Its disabled state is a deliberate flat fill, not a faded blue.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; margin-right: 8px; background: #1B46C5; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #13309A; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #1B46C5; } .ds-btn:disabled { background: #C9C0B1; color: #5A5F68; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action sitting inside a ruled band.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #14161A; border: 1px solid #C9C4BA; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #1B46C5; color: #1B46C5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #1B46C5; }

components.name: Sheet with ruled bands
components.description: The system's only container. A stack of full-bleed horizontal bands divided by hairlines — never a grid of nested boxes.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E3DFD9; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(20 22 26 / 0.05), 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(20 22 26 / 0.04); overflow: hidden; } .ds-band { padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E3DFD9; } .ds-band-plain { padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-band-foot { padding: 16px 24px; background: #FAF8F5; border-top: 1px solid #E3DFD9; } .ds-rule-band { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E3DFD9; } .ds-tick { display: block; width: 3px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: #1B46C5; } .ds-label { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5A5F68; } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.024em; color: #14161A; } .ds-sheet-sub { margin: 6px 0 0; max-width: 68ch; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.625; color: #42454D; } .ds-body { margin: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.625; color: #42454D; } .ds-body-sm { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #5A5F68; }

components.css: .ds-titleblock { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E3DFD9; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-titleblock > div { padding: 14px 20px; border-left: 1px solid #E3DFD9; } .ds-titleblock > div:first-child { border-left: none; } .ds-tb-val { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: #14161A; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-titleblock { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

components.name: Index Tab
components.description: Rail navigation. The active tab takes the white sheet fill and pulls a pixel right to sit over the rail edge — the binder-tab gesture.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: 12px; background: #DFD9CD; border-right: 1px solid #C9C0B1; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; width: 100%; margin-right: -1px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-left: none; border-right: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(233, 228, 216, 0.6); } .ds-tab--active { background: #FFFFFF; border-top-color: #C9C0B1; border-bottom-color: #C9C0B1; } .ds-tab-mark { display: block; width: 3px; height: 14px; margin-top: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab-mark { background: #1B46C5; } .ds-tab-icon { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; color: #5A5F68; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab-icon { color: #1B46C5; } .ds-tab-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-tab-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab-label { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #42454D; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab-label { color: #14161A; } .ds-tab-count { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #5A5F68; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tab-desc { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; color: #5A5F68; }

components.name: Priority Mark
components.description: Priority encoded by fill density rather than hue, so the scale survives greyscale printing and colour-blind reading. There is no pill.
components.html: HighMediumLow
components.css: .ds-pri { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 16px; } .ds-pri-sq { display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; border: 1px solid; } .ds-pri-sq--high { background: #1B46C5; border-color: #1B46C5; } .ds-pri-sq--med { background: rgba(27, 70, 197, 0.4); border-color: rgba(27, 70, 197, 0.6); } .ds-pri-sq--low { background: transparent; border-color: #C9C4BA; } .ds-pri-t { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pri-t--high { color: #1B46C5; } .ds-pri-t--med { color: #42454D; } .ds-pri-t--low { color: #5A5F68; }

components.name: Register Row
components.description: The previous-runs list. Zero-padded index, document name, excerpt, and a right-aligned tabular metric group that hides on small screens.
components.css: .ds-register { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E3DFD9; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-register li + li { border-top: 1px solid #E3DFD9; } .ds-reg-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-reg-row:hover { background: #EEF1FC; } .ds-reg-idx { flex-shrink: 0; width: 24px; margin-top: 2px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #5A5F68; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-reg-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-reg-name { display: block; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #14161A; } .ds-reg-exc { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; color: #5A5F68; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-reg-meta { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #42454D; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-reg-date { color: #5A5F68; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-reg-meta { display: none; } }

components.name: Drop Target
components.description: The only dashed edge in the system. A dashed border means one thing: this surface accepts a file.
components.css: .ds-drop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 20px; text-align: left; background: #FAF8F5; border: 1px dashed #C9C4BA; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-drop:hover { border-color: #1B46C5; background: #EEF1FC; } .ds-drop:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #1B46C5; } .ds-drop-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 36px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #C9C4BA; border-radius: 3px; color: #42454D; } .ds-drop-title { display: block; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #14161A; } .ds-drop-sub { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; color: #5A5F68; }

narrative.overview:
QA coverage is filed, not fed. The interface is a ring binder of technical specifications: beige index stock holds the tabs, white sheets hold the work, and a single ink blue does every job that ink blue does in a printed spec — rules a section, marks the pulled tab, numbers a procedure step, and flags what is critical. Nothing floats, nothing glows, nothing is translucent. A surface is either stock or sheet, and you always know which one you are looking at.

The register is precise and instrumental. Hierarchy comes from weight and rule placement rather than from size, color, or elevation: the largest type on any screen is 26px, and it earns its authority by being the only 600-weight thing above 17px. Secondary information is not made quiet by graying it into illegibility — every text color in this system was measured against the beige stock, not just against white, because stock is the darkest ground secondary text ever sits on.

This world deliberately refuses two neighbours. It is not the dark AI-tool dashboard with a neon accent and a sparkle icon, and it is not the warm-cream editorial calm it replaced — an aesthetic that put a 48px literary serif over a gradient field and asked a QA engineer under deadline to admire it. The binder answers the same content with flat value separation, hairlines, and tabular numerals.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: beige stock and white sheet, separated by value and a hairline
One accent — ink blue — carrying rules, tabs, step numbers, and priority alike
Weight and rule position carry hierarchy; size range is deliberately narrow
Priority encoded by fill density, not hue, so it survives monochrome and colour-blind reading
Radii of 2–8px, no translucency, no gradient, one near-invisible shadow

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: A surface is stock or it is sheet. There is no third ground, no translucency between them, and no gradient inside either. If you need a new level, recess to Paper Sunk — do not invent a tint.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only chromatic value in the interface. Priority, status, success, and warning must all be expressed in ink weight, fill density, or position. The moment a second hue appears, the blue stops meaning anything.

rules.name: The Measured-On-Stock Rule
rules.body: Every text colour is verified against Stock Sunk, not against white. Stock is the darkest ground secondary text sits on, so it sets the contrast floor for the whole system.

rules.name: The Narrow Range Rule
rules.body: The whole system lives between 11px and 26px. If something needs more emphasis, it gets more weight or a rule above it — never a larger size. A 48px display would break the binder immediately.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist sets everything, including numerals and labels. Do not introduce a mono face to signal technical — tabular numerals already do that job, and a second family would make this a different document.

rules.name: No Eyebrows
rules.body: A small tracked label never sits above a heading to introduce it. Labels mark regions — a section rule, a title-block field — and always stand alone with no heading beneath them. Headings carry their own weight.

rules.name: The Ruled Band Rule
rules.body: Sheets divide into full-bleed horizontal bands separated by 1px rules. Never nest a bordered box inside a sheet to group content — add a band and rule it.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Split Rule
rules.body: The master–detail split favours the detail side. Reading a case matters more than choosing one.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: State is signalled by fill and rule, never by elevation. Hover changes background; selection changes background; nothing lifts.

rules.name: The Dashed-Means-Drop Rule
rules.body: A dashed border appears on exactly one thing: a surface that accepts a file.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: Status and metadata are set as type with a mark beside them, not as filled rounded capsules. A pill in this interface is a foreign object.

dos: Do build a sheet as a stack of full-bleed ruled bands.
Do keep every chromatic decision on the single Ink Blue.
Do encode priority, status, and severity by fill density or weight.
Do verify text colours against Stock Sunk, not only against white.
Do use tabular numerals for anything that aligns in a column.
Do hold the type range between 11px and 26px, and reach for weight when you need emphasis.
Do keep radii at 4px for surfaces and controls.
donts: Don't introduce translucency, backdrop blur, or a gradient. The world is flat by construction.
Don't put a small tracked label above a heading. Labels mark regions and stand alone.
Don't add a second accent hue, or reintroduce hue-coded severity.
Don't nest a bordered box inside a sheet — add a ruled band instead.
Don't use pills or capsules for status or metadata.
Don't signal state with elevation; change fill or rule.
Don't add a monospace face to look technical. Tabular Geist already is.
Don't let a display size above 26px into the interface.
Don't reintroduce --bullish, --bearish, --neutral, or --confidence — inherited scaffold tokens with no consumer, removed with this world.
